info.background_text:
Romance-chasing adventurer.
A member of White Altair, she enjoys thrilling adventures, seeking fun, excitement, and treasure. Even the most trivial items found during her adventures are considered treasures, and she joyfully celebrates their discovery with a childlike innocence.
